description:
Start an MP4 recording of the device screen. Use when the user wants a video of an interaction or animation. Use `screenshot` for a still image.
Recording continues across tool calls until stopped or until the time limit. Set a reminder as soon as recording starts. The start result returns `outputFile` on the tool-server host. Retrieve the video with `screen-recording-stop`, even after the time limit.
Start fails if the target is unavailable or already has a recording waiting to be stopped or retrieved. Local simulators, Android emulators and devices, and cabled iPhones require ffmpeg. On a physical iPhone, check for `transportType: "wired"` in `list-devices` and have the user allow camera access for `ios-screen-stream` if prompted on the first recording. tvOS, Chromium, and Vega are unsupported.

showTouches.description: Draw touch markers in the video (default true). Recordings of physical iPhones have no touch markers.

timeLimitSeconds.description: Auto-stop cap in seconds (default 180). Set it to slightly more than the interaction you plan to capture. Range: 1 to 600.

trimStatic.description: Default true. Collapse stretches where the screen does not change: the first second of each still stretch is kept, then unchanged frames are dropped until something moves again, so a long recording with brief activity comes back short instead of full of dead air. Set false to keep a faithful real-time recording.

name: screen-recording-start
